components.title: Schema migrations runner + new tables/columns
components.description: Adds a numbered SQL migration runner to praxis/storage/, the schema_migrations tracking table, follow_ups column additions (user_chosen, display_text, superseded_by), the partial-unique active-commitment index, the session_reflections table, and aug_auto_classification + aug_auto_confidence on session_scores. Foundation for every loop verb.

components.title: Expanded behavioral signals + knowledge-gap classifier
components.description: Adds ~15 new signals to praxis/behavior/signals.py (specification-artifact, error-naming, iterative-refinement, plan-mode-invocation, scaffolding-artifact, TDD marker, recipe, context-and-instructions, verification-depth graded, repeat-task signature, cadence high-adopter, code-comprehension, tool/agent ladder) plus the four-subtype knowledge-gap classifier. Ships with fixtures so signals are reviewable. Backwards-compatible additions to BehavioralSignals.

components.title: Augmentation/automation classifier
components.description: New praxis/behavior/aug_auto.py module that classifies each session as augmentation, automation, or mixed via a single cheap-tier LLM call (Haiku 4.5 / gpt-5-mini), with strict JSON output. Integrated into the orchestrator pass-1 path alongside the rubric judge. Persisted via the aug_auto columns added by schema-migrations.

components.title: Cadence detector
components.description: New praxis/behavior/cadence.py module computing weekday-active streaks and high-adopter spectrum position from arXiv 2509.19708 over a configurable window. Reads existing session_scores; no schema additions.

components.title: Repeat-task detector
components.description: New praxis/behavior/repeat_task.py module that extends the existing cluster_sessions output to flag tasks recurring 3+ times within a window, using token overlap on user-turn first-sentences (v1; semantic embeddings deferred to v2 per Section 12). No new dependencies.

components.title: `praxis nudge` command
components.description: The single reader of the active commitment. Adds the new verb to praxis/cli/__main__.py with --format {claude-code,codex,text}, throttling via ~/.praxis/.last_nudge, and config.toml [nudge] section. Also rewires shell-nudge to delegate here so all surfaces share throttle state.

components.title: `praxis commit` command
components.description: New `commit` verb: presents three suggestions plus prior-commitment-keep plus free-text option, handles 280-char cap with re-prompt, handles mid-week replace (keep/replace/cancel) with superseded_by, and persists user_chosen + display_text. Pulls suggestions from headline-moment, weakest-dim drills (coach.py), and prior commitment.

components.title: `praxis reflect` command
components.description: New `reflect` verb with the 30-second post-session check-in. Handles --session-end as the Stop-hook entrypoint: parses Claude Code or Codex JSON payload from stdin, gates on >=2 turns + >=60s, launches the interactive prompt in a detached child when not on a TTY, and writes session_reflections rows (including skip rows with reasons).

components.title: `praxis install-coach` and `uninstall-coach`
components.description: Adds the bootstrapper verbs to praxis/cli/__main__.py. Auto-detects Claude Code (~/.claude/), Codex (~/.codex/), and Copilot (VS Code workspace) and prompts per-tool. Installs hooks via JSON merging with `_praxisManaged: true` sentinels and atomic writes; the Copilot installer writes both the workspace `.github/copilot-instructions.md` managed block and (gated) the user-level `*.instructions.md` file. Uninstall removes only entries with the sentinel.

components.title: Rename `praxis week` to `praxis review` + new masthead
components.description: Renames the verb and its cmd_week function to cmd_review (no alias). Rewrites the digest masthead in both terminal and HTML renderers to lead with commitment status, the you-said vs data-says comparison, and the gap-detection paragraph. Adds the TTY-gated [k]eep / [n]ew / [d]igest prompt with a --non-interactive flag for scripted use. Adds run_weekly's commitment+reflection rollup, fed via adapter.py to both renderers.

components.title: Report panels expansion (behavioral, balance, cadence, repeat-task, calibration, spec, context, gaps, ladder, cost)
components.description: Adds 10 new panels to digest_html.py and digest_terminal.py, fed by behavioral-signals-expansion, augmentation-automation-classifier, cadence-detector, and repeat-task-detector. praxis/reports/adapter.py carries the new panel inputs. Each panel cites a primary source from Section 14 and degrades gracefully when underlying data is sparse.

components.title: README + `praxis --help` rewrite
components.description: Full rewrite of README.md to lead with the four-verb loop, drop the word 'scorecard' entirely, and present the rubric as the evidence layer underneath. Reorganises `praxis --help` to lead with commit/nudge/reflect/review/install-coach and group secondary verbs under a 'More' section.
